verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no general-purpose API that mirrors the UI. Filing, payment, extensions, address changes and account management live behind the authenticated Webfile/eSystems portal, and all OpenAPI probes return 404. The only machine-readable surface is a read-only Socrata open-data dataset, and the probe states that no public filing or payment endpoint exists. EDI and approved third-party preparer software are separate submission channels, not documented UI-parity APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: the Comptroller's Active Franchise Tax Permit Holders dataset answers a keyless Socrata SODA query with structured JSON rows
